title: Bend 2 and the Vibe-Coding Trap
summary: A blog post discussing 'Bend 2', a parallel programming language, and the pitfalls of 'vibe-coding'—writing code by intuition and AI assistance without deep understanding. The author argues that while AI tools make coding feel effortless, they can mask fundamental gaps in comprehension, leading to fragile systems. The piece sparked a 320-point Hacker News discussion with 231 comments debating AI-assisted development practices.
